result: Sox Teacher def. Jo Mamas 5–4 (1 tie)
writeup:
### The arc
Jo Mamas ran this week almost start to finish — ahead by Monday night, around 80% midweek, peaking at 93% Saturday morning — carried by **hits (59-51), steals (10-2), OPS (.766-.668) and saves+holds (8-4)**. Sox Teacher answered with all four starter categories, **K 52-31, QS 4-2, ERA and WHIP**, which left the board level at 5-5. Level categories go to the hits tiebreaker, and Jo Mamas led that by eight, so the whole matchup came down to one thing: holding **runs, 37-36**.

### What swung it
- **Aug 2, afternoon** - **Miguel Vargas**' two-run homer, and **Jake McCarthy**'s three-run shot half an hour later, kept Sox Teacher's bats in it and cut Jo Mamas to ~60%.
- **Aug 2, evening** - Sox Teacher's starters came apart: **Landen Roupp** was charged 5 ER in 4 2/3, **Jake Bennett** 3 more, dragging their ERA and WHIP the wrong way and lifting Jo Mamas back to ~88%.
- **Aug 3, 8th inning of the night's last game** - **Caleb Durbin** was hit by a pitch, moved up on **Andruw Monasterio**'s single and **Jarren Duran**'s sacrifice bunt, and scored on **Anthony Seigler**'s sacrifice fly. Runs tied **37-37**.

**Turning point:** that one run. A tied category counts for neither side, so 5-5-plus-the-tiebreaker became 4-5-1 - Jo Mamas fell from 80% to 2% in a single five-minute update, with every one of their own games already finished and nothing left to answer with.
